title: Red Hoods training routine
author: Gary Wall
desc:
The purpose of this program is to help people build the physical build of modern day Red Hood, standing at 6’1 225lbs Red hood’s physique is not gonna be easy to reach but with determination and discipline it is attainable

I came back and made some edits and tweaks to try and make the workouts shorter but hit harder with more weight and hypertrophy work, but still keep the body weight work and fighting for certain cardio days

ex.note:
Work up to a heavy set
For the first two sets you should be working hard towards technical failure 
For your last set go to just one rep before technical failure 
Rest 2-3 min

Controlled reps try to not use momentum to force movement
start light and build up trying to burn out the muscle more and more while striving for the same amount of reps 
Rest 90s-2mi

Have the assisted weight at no more than half your body weight for the first set 
For the second only move the weight up 20lbs assisted and strive for the same number of reps
90s rest

With these keep it slow and controlled pausing for one second at the top and bottom of the movement 
Go to complete failure first set then lower the weight and try to get the same reps
90s rest

Try to keep form strict, with little hip movement 
Rest 90s

Use whatever grip you are comfortable with
Slowly lower the weight then pause at the bottom 
For both sets go to complete failure and really push yourself 
Rest 60-90s
Warm up your body and legs especially since we are hitting home hard to burn them out

You can do any squat variation you like, but these definitely make it easier to reach failure
Do slow controlled reps pausing at parallel for tow seconds the go up
Rest 2-3 minutes

Put a weight under the heels and really focus on getting a deep squat
Rest 90s-2min

Keep the weight controlled down and pause at the top
With both sets go close to failure only stopping 2 reps before 
Rest 90s-2min

Keep the movement controlled and smooth without using too much momentum to force reps
Rest 90s-2min

Use weight as needed but this for the most part is used to stretched the back of your legs and lower back
Keep these very slow to encourage a stretch 
Rest 60-90s

Work the rotation part of you core to help with punching 
Touch each side add weight as needed
Rest 30s

ss.note: Use this to train your power with good technique
Work on speed with good technique

ex.note: It’s fine if you shake these are not supposed to be easy, really flex your core while doing this

If you can’t do this do a normal leg raise 
Rest 90s

Keep these very explosive try to slam the ball against the wall as hard as you can, each side
Rest 90s

Stretch out your back and keep it slow and really accentuate the stretch
Do this on each side￼
Really take your time to feel the stretch so you can be ready for the rest of the week
Get the upper body warm and set to build some strength

Do either Barbell or dumbbell your choice,
Keep these controlled on the way down and explosive on the way up
Rest 2-3min

Make these very explosive on the way up then controlled down
Rest 90s

As these get easier elevate you feet and hands to provide more of a stretch, we’re trying to eventually work to a handstand 
Rest 90s

Overall movement needs to be controlled not to fast or slow
Rest 90s

Still have to get some upper chest work in 
Keep these slow 5sec down and explosive on the way up
Rest 90s

Pinch your shoulder blades and get a weight you can control well
Rest 90s

Keep weight control and get to parallel before firing back up, use belt with heavier weight
Rest 2-3 min

When lifting it should be very fast and explosive with lower weight, when lowering the bar slowly lower it
Rest 2min

Slowly lower then fire back up if it hurts your lower back use a belt
Rest 90s-2min

The jumping part should be explosive go for height but when you land slowly go into the lunge 
Rest 90s

Use a bench while working on form once getting comfortable take away the bench and use a rack to help stay stable
Rest 90s 
Each side

Work on explosive height here try pushing yourself as far as you can with the height of the boxes then after 2 weeks change to quick taps on a small box
